item.title: Mt Zion Independent Church to Hold Free Food Giveaway on Sunday, December 14
item.description: Mt Zion Independent Church will be giving away free boxes of non-perishable food to families who are need of assistance on Sunday, Dec. 14. The distribution will begin at 5 p.m. and will continue until all boxes are gone. The church is located at 7580 County Road 91 Gaylesville (in the Rinehart Community).
